name: copilot-simulations
description: Local evidence-linked shipping-policy experiments with a deterministic panel ledger and explicit Copilot model configuration.

scripts.test: npm run test:legacy && npm run test:simulations
scripts.test:legacy: node test/ai-engine-unit.mjs && node test/scenario-smoke.mjs && node test/retail-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:simulations: node --test test/runtime-unit.mjs test/copilot-harness-unit.mjs test/domain-unit.mjs test/persistence-unit.mjs test/orchestration-unit.mjs test/local-access-unit.mjs test/legacy-regression.mjs test/http-integration.mjs test/walkthrough-unit.mjs test/conversation-unit.mjs test/people-graph-unit.mjs
